title: ever SOL|Short Sleeve V-Neck Pleated Glitter Midi Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into the spotlight in our Short Sleeve V-Neck Pleated Asymmetrical Midi Wedding Guest Dress! This stunning piece features a flattering V-neckline and elegantly pleated detailing that adds texture and movement. The asymmetrical hemline creates a modern twist, making it perfect for both formal and semi-formal occasions. Whether you're dancing the night away or mingling at the reception, you'll radiate style and grace in this must-have wedding guest outfit!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length


Sleeve Style: Short sleeve


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises glitter


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch
